# Complete independently seeded method scopes

Owned three- and four-formal static void methods use a nongeneric state context
and separate scalar indices. Frozen reflection checks every independent method
formal, complete erased descriptor, flags and exceptions before initialization.

The observer checks earlier size/later array snapshots across a mutable callback,
all opaque input identities, nulls, aliasing and overlapping stores, plus partial
state after failures at every store position. Source and dependency-provider
profiles preserve all original definitions/metadata, compile every recovered
Java file, and run only this owned fixture. Same-code signature mutations and
independently compiled wrong programs must fail the unchanged observer.
